issue.title: Fix stale contract manifest and contract-set budget failure
issue.description: Discovered while verifying retire_coder_alias_bucket on 2026-08-10. Serial pytest reports tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection failing because collect_contract_files() currently selects tests/test_probe_core_floor_tool.py but tests/contract_manifest.txt does not list it. The companion tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_set_manifest_entry_budget_has_no_hidden_headroom also fails because the committed manifest has 38 entries while _MANIFEST_ENTRY_BUDGET remains 36, so this needs deliberate contract-set re-curation or an updated measured budget, not just an incidental refresh in an unrelated model-alias patch.
